methodologyNotes: Roster covers 13 high-search wireless phone charger models spanning pads, stands, 3-in-1 and 2-in-1 configurations from Anker, Belkin, Apple, ESR, Mophie, Nomad, UGREEN, Spigen, and Baseus. Primary sources are manufacturer product pages (anker.com, belkin.com, apple.com, esrtech.com, mophie.com, nomadgoods.com, us.ugreen.com, spigen.com, baseus.com); corroborating sources include Amazon/Best Buy listings and editorial reviews (9to5toys, MacRumors, Macworld, How-To Geek, Cult of Mac, The Gadgeteer). All wattages are peak headline output. priceUsd is published US MSRP/list price. Adversarial re-verification on 2026-06-19 corrected: Anker A2557 price (sale price mistaken for MSRP); Apple MagSafe release date/year (the Qi2 25W MGD74LL/A is the Sept 2025 third-gen model, not the Oct 2024 charger); Mophie certification (Made-for-MagSafe/MFi, not Qi2); ESR source URL (wrong .io domain corrected to .com); Baseus foldable flag (confirmed foldable). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Anker MagGo Wireless Charging Station (3-in-1, Foldable Pad) A25M8
products.priceNote: MSRP $109.99 per anker.com (currently on sale to $89.99)
products.provenance: Anker.com product page (re-verified 2026-06-19) confirms list price $109.99 (sale $89.99), 15W Max phone output (5W Watch / 5W earbuds), MPP(Qi2) certified, foldable compact pad, charges iPhone+Apple Watch+AirPods simultaneously, 40W USB-C adapter included. 9to5toys IFA 2024 coverage confirms 2024 release.

products.name: Anker MagGo Wireless Charging Station (Foldable 3-in-1) A2557
products.priceNote: MSRP $139.99 per anker.com (currently on sale to $109.99)
products.provenance: CORRECTED: Anker.com product page (re-verified 2026-06-19) shows list price $139.99 with $30 OFF to $109.99 currently — the draft's $109.99 was the sale price, not MSRP. 15W Max phone (25W total), genuine Qi2 module, charges 3 devices, foldable to 3.50 x 2.36 x 0.98 in, 40W USB-C PD wall charger included. Distinct model from the A25M8 pad. September 2024 announcement per 9to5toys IFA coverage.

products.name: Apple MagSafe Charger (1 m) — Qi2 25W (2025)
products.priceNote: MSRP $39 (1 m); $49 for 2 m. Cable only — power adapter sold separately
products.provenance: CORRECTED release date/year: the Qi2 25W-certified MagSafe Charger (model MGD74LL/A) is Apple's THIRD-generation MagSafe Charger, released September 10, 2025 — NOT October 2024. The earlier 2024 charger also did 25W for iPhone but was NOT Qi2-certified. Since this product is named/specced as the Qi2 25W charger, release is 2025-09. MSRP $39 (1 m) / $49 (2 m) confirmed by Apple.com and MacRumors; requires a separately-sold 30W+ USB-C adapter for full 25W; charges one device. Fabricated How-To Geek '2024 review' corroboration replaced with the MacRumors launch article.

products.name: Belkin BoostCharge Pro 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Stand with Qi2 15W (WIZ032)
products.provenance: Belkin product page and 9to5toys confirm $120 regular price, 15W Qi2 magnetic pad for iPhone, dedicated 5W Apple Watch puck and 5W AirPods pad, power supply included (Belkin lists 40W; Amazon SKU lists 36W variant — adapter included either way), non-foldable stand, November 2024 release. Source URL corrected to the live WIZ032ttBK colorway page.

products.name: Mophie 3-in-1 Portable Travel Charger with MagSafe (2023)
products.provenance: CORRECTED certification: Mophie.com lists this as 'Made for MagSafe — MFi Certified', NOT Qi2 — the draft's 'Qi2' claim was wrong (a 2023 MagSafe charger predates Qi2 ecosystem; the Qi2 label is unsupported). $150 MSRP, 15W MagSafe phone output, folds into compact travel case, 30W USB-C PD adapter and USB-C cable included, 2023 edition. qi2_or_magsafe boolean kept true (it is MagSafe). Price and year confirmed.

products.name: ESR HaloLock 3-in-1 Travel Wireless Charging Set
products.priceNote: Regular price per esrtech.com; frequently on sale to ~$64.99
products.provenance: CORRECTED source URL: draft used non-existent esrtech.io domain; the live page is esrtech.com/products/halolock-3-in-1-travel-wireless-charging-set, which confirms $86.99 regular price, '15W 3-in-1 Travel Wireless Charging Set', MagSafe-compatible HaloLock, charges iPhone+AirPods+Apple Watch with removable Watch dongle, folds into travel case. Power adapter inclusion not stated on the page (left null); release year not published (null).

products.name: Nomad Stand One (4th Gen, Qi2.2)
products.provenance: Nomad.com and MacRumors/Cult of Mac/The Gadgeteer confirm $119 USD, 25W Qi2.2 for iPhone plus base Qi coil for AirPods (2 devices, no Watch charger), 40W+ USB-C adapter required but not included, USB-C cable included, metal+glass build, early November 2025 release.

products.name: Nomad Stand One Max (4th Gen, Qi2.2)
products.provenance: Nomad.com and editorial sources (Cult of Mac, The Gadgeteer, Macworld) confirm $159 USD, 25W Qi2.2, adds an Apple Watch fast charger to the Stand One for a full 3-in-1 (iPhone+Watch+AirPods), 40W+ adapter not included, USB-C cable included, metal+glass construction, November 2025 release.

products.name: UGREEN MagFlow 3-in-1 Magnetic Wireless Desktop Charger 25W
products.provenance: UGREEN US product page confirms $139.99 regular price (currently discounted), 25W Qi2 MagSafe-compatible, charges iPhone+AirPods+Apple Watch simultaneously, weighted adjustable desk stand (non-foldable). Adapter inclusion not confirmed on the desktop model page (left null). 2025 launch.

products.name: UGREEN MagFlow 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charger 25W
products.provenance: 9to5toys Dec 2025 hands-on confirms 25W Qi2.2, foldable ultra-compact design, 45W USB-C wall adapter and cable included, charges 3 devices. Regular price ~$140 (sale to $89.99) per editorial sources; Amazon ASIN B0DZX533Y1 confirms the product. 2025 release.

products.name: Anker 313 Wireless Charger (Pad) A2503
products.provenance: Anker.com (re-verified 2026-06-19) confirms $23.99 price, Qi-certified (not Qi2/MagSafe), 10W max for Samsung / 7.5W iPhone / 5W standard, slim pad, no AC adapter included (requires QC 2.0/3.0 adapter for max speed), charges one device. Release year not published by Anker (null).

products.name: Spigen ArcField Magnetic 15W Wireless Charger PF2200 (MagFit)
products.provenance: Spigen product page confirms $74.99, 15W Made-for-MagSafe (MFM/MagFit) single-device magnetic pad with integrated pop-up kickstand and 6.6-ft braided cable, no power adapter included. Release year not published (null). Amazon B09MJW72CS corroborates.

products.name: Baseus PicoGo AF21 3-in-1 Qi2.2 Wireless Charger
products.provenance: CORRECTED foldable null->true: Baseus product page, Amazon listing (B0FRLZFGRY) and Macworld review all describe a FOLDABLE design ('folded to be as small as a deck of cards', 2.97 x 3.15 x 1.5 in). ~$89.99 (sold out at time of draft access), officially Qi2.2, 25W iPhone / 5W Watch / 5W earbuds, 45W USB-C wall charger and cable included, charges 3 devices, 2025 release.
